name: Moon Canopy
summary: A low courtyard mosque nestles beneath a broad paper crescent that turns into its right-hand silhouette.
why: The dome and open doorway share x=54, and the door crown has three units of wall above it. The crescent occupies the upper sky as a broad canopy. Its six-by-five-unit terminal is physically overlapped by the right wing at x=70..76, y=61..66, creating a solid joint. The paper fold follows the lower right corner.
risk: The crescent is intentionally prominent. At small sizes the combined contour remains clear, while the lower wall fold becomes a simple warm corner.
reasonToChoose: You want a clear mosque silhouette shaped through broad paper planes and generous openings.
